newsHighlights.title: President invites global firms to share in China's development
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping invited businesses worldwide to share in China's development, pledging to open the vast market further and create more opportunities for companies to innovate and grow.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席邀请全球企业共享中国发展机遇，承诺进一步开放广阔市场，为企业创新与成长创造更多机会。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's speech at APEC CEO Summit resonates with global business leaders
newsHighlights.summary: Xi's keynote speech at the APEC CEO Summit in Shenzhen resonated strongly with global business leaders, who hailed China's commitment to openness and win-win cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平在深圳APEC工商领导人峰会上的主旨演讲引起全球商界领袖强烈共鸣，他们赞赏中国对开放与合作共赢的承诺。

newsHighlights.title: Xi says China-Russia relations bring stability, certainty to turbulent world
newsHighlights.summary: Xi said that China-Russia relations have brought greater stability and certainty to a world of turbulence and transformation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平表示，中俄关系为动荡变革的世界带来了更大的稳定性与确定性。

newsHighlights.title: Why ASEAN integration matters for the Asia-Pacific
newsHighlights.summary: Deeper ASEAN integration is widely seen as a key driver of regional growth and connectivity across the Asia-Pacific economy.
newsHighlights.translation: 更深入的东盟一体化被普遍视为亚太地区经济增长与互联互通的关键驱动力。

newsHighlights.title: What does APEC's innovation priority look like on the ground in Shenzhen?
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen's tech hubs and startups offer a vivid picture of how APEC's innovation priority is being turned into real-world business practice.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳的科技中心与初创企业生动展示了APEC的创新优先议程如何转化为现实的商业实践。

quote.quote: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
quote.author: Peter Drucker
quote.translation: 预测未来最好的方式就是创造未来。
quote.explanation: 管理学大师德鲁克认为，企业不应被动等待市场变化，而应通过创新与开放主动塑造未来。这与今日新闻中全球企业共享中国发展机遇、以创新驱动增长的主题高度契合。

vocabulary.translation: 中国承诺进一步向外资企业开放其广阔市场。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 "pledging to open its vast market further"。

vocabulary.example: Global firms are eager to reach China's vast consumer market.
vocabulary.translation: 全球企业渴望进入中国广阔的消费市场。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "pledging to open its vast market further" 中对市场规模的描述。

vocabulary.example: Bilateral trade has brought stability to the regional economy.
vocabulary.translation: 双边贸易为地区经济带来了稳定性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 "bring greater stability and certainty to a world of turbulence"。

vocabulary.example: Investors value policy certainty when making long-term decisions.
vocabulary.translation: 投资者在做长期决策时重视政策的确定性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "bring greater stability and certainty to a turbulent world" 一语。

vocabulary.example: Global markets have shown turbulence in recent months.
vocabulary.translation: 近几个月全球市场表现出动荡。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 "a world of turbulence and transformation" 的表述。

vocabulary.example: ASEAN integration matters greatly for the Asia-Pacific economy.
vocabulary.translation: 东盟一体化对亚太经济至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 分析文章 "Why ASEAN integration matters for the Asia-Pacific"。

vocabulary.newsContext: 出自报道 "APEC's innovation priority" 及 "opportunities for companies to innovate and grow"。

vocabulary.example: Regional development and connectivity were stressed at the meeting.
vocabulary.translation: 会议强调了区域发展与互联互通。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道标题 "Regional development, connectivity stressed"。

vocabulary.example: The president's speech resonated with global business leaders.
vocabulary.translation: 主席的演讲引起了全球商界领袖的共鸣。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道 "Xi's speech at APEC CEO Summit resonates with global business leaders"。

vocabulary.example: A welcome banquet was hosted for guests attending the APEC meeting.
vocabulary.translation: 为出席APEC会议的来宾举办了欢迎宴会。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道 "Xi hosts welcome banquet for guests attending APEC meeting"。

pattern.pattern: invite sb. to do sth.（邀请某人做某事）/ share in sth.（共享某事物）
pattern.example: President Xi Jinping invited businesses worldwide to share in China's development.
pattern.translation: 习近平主席邀请全球企业共享中国的发展机遇。
pattern.usage: invite + 宾语 + to do 表示“邀请某人做某事”；share in + 名词表示“分享、共享（机会、成果、发展等）”。该句型常用于商业与外交语境，表达开放合作的意愿。例如：The company invited startups to share in its growth platform.（该公司邀请初创企业共享其增长平台。）

grammar.title: 现在完成时表示持续至今的影响（Present Perfect for Lasting Impact）
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）用于强调过去发生的动作对现在仍有持续影响。在商业与外交新闻中，常用来总结政策或关系到目前为止取得的成果。注意与一般过去时的区别：一般过去时只陈述过去事实，现在完成时突出“至今仍有效”的结果。
examples: China-Russia relations have brought greater stability and certainty to a world of turbulence and transformation.
China has pledged to open its vast market further and create more opportunities for companies to innovate and grow.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /ˈsɜː/，/t/ 后的 /n/ 为成音节辅音（syllabic /n/），舌尖抵上齿龈、声带振动，直接读作“tnti”，中间不要插入元音 /ə/。注意与 certainly /ˈsɜːtnli/ 区分。
examples: Policy certainty gives investors the confidence to commit capital.
There is no certainty that the market will recover quickly.

reading.title: Shenzhen Welcomes the World: APEC and the Promise of Open Markets
reading.content:
Shenzhen, one of China's most dynamic business hubs, is hosting the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting this week. On Wednesday, President Xi Jinping invited businesses worldwide to share in China's development, pledging to open the country's vast market further and create more opportunities for companies to innovate and grow.

Speaking at the APEC CEO Summit, Xi stressed that openness and cooperation bring stability and certainty to a turbulent world. His remarks resonated with global business leaders, who said China's commitment to win-win cooperation offers clear guidance for long-term investment.

Analysts also pointed to deeper ASEAN integration and stronger regional connectivity as key drivers of Asia-Pacific growth. With APEC placing innovation at the top of its agenda, Shenzhen's tech startups and manufacturers offer a vivid picture of what that priority looks like on the ground.
reading.translation:
深圳是中国最具活力的商业中心之一，本周正在举办第33届亚太经济合作组织会议。周三，习近平主席邀请全球企业共享中国的发展机遇，承诺进一步开放中国广阔的市场，为企业创新与成长创造更多机会。

习近平在APEC工商领导人峰会上强调，开放合作能为动荡的世界带来稳定与确定性。他的讲话引起了全球商界领袖的共鸣，他们表示，中国对合作共赢的承诺为长期投资提供了清晰指引。

分析人士还指出，更深入的东盟一体化和更强的区域互联互通是亚太增长的关键驱动力。随着APEC把创新置于议程首位，深圳的科技初创企业与制造商生动展现了这一优先事项在现实中的模样。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily 与 CGTN 于2026年11月19日关于APEC深圳会议、习近平主席在APEC工商领导人峰会讲话及区域经济一体化的多篇真实报道改写。
